remaining_acceptance: A selected candidate still needs the preregistered >=900000-interaction stability window, two other scratch seeds, independent frozen testing and separate LiDAR training.
limits: Control interfaces differ from the historical full3D BPTT/SHAC recipes and must be disclosed in the matrix.
